lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible; inter-line spacing is widest in the mid-torso region and decreases in the posterior flank area.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Truncated line segments observed at the anterior shoulder and posterior haunch regions where lines terminate before traversing the full vertical torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: 3 distinct high-contrast white spots are visible on the lateral posterior haunch above the hind limb junction.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiraling lyrate curvature; horns exhibit lateral-posterior divergence from the frontal bone followed by medial-anterior convergence at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.5 times the pixel width of an individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The ivory-colored terminal tips comprise approximately 20% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse chevron between the eyes, white spots on the lower mandible/cheek, and a white dorsal mane extending along the spinal ridge.
